extensionName.description: Extension name shown in the Web Store and chrome://extensions

extensionDescription.description: Extension description shown in the Web Store and chrome://extensions
extensionDescription.message: Interactive map overlay for nehnutelnosti.sk — addresses from listings are auto-geocoded onto OpenStreetMap and shown as markers with price, area or title. Filters by price and area, favorites, local cache.

clearCache.description: Button that clears the geocoding cache

clearing.description: Status while the cache is being cleared

cleared.description: Status after the cache has been cleared

geocodingBy.description: Footer credit for the geocoding service

expand.description: Tooltip for the floating button that opens the overlay from minimized state

minimize.description: Tooltip for the button that collapses the overlay into the floating button

expandHorizontal.description: Tooltip for the button that expands the overlay to full screen width

expandVertical.description: Tooltip for the button that expands the overlay to full screen height

favoriteOn.description: Label for a listing already marked as favorite

favoriteOff.description: Label for a listing not yet marked as favorite

showOnPage.description: Button that scrolls the listing into view on the host page

areaRange.description: Label for the dual-handle area range slider

markerLabelSetting.description: Label for the dropdown in Settings that picks the marker label type

markerLabelToggle.description: Tooltip for the header button that cycles the marker label type

markerLabelNone.description: Option: render markers as plain dots without a label

markerLabelPrice.description: Option: render the listing price as the marker label

markerLabelTitle.description: Option: render the listing title as the marker label

markerLabelArea.description: Option: render the listing area in m² as the marker label

transparentSetting.description: Label of the checkbox in Settings for the semi-transparent overlay

transparentSettingHint.description: Helper text under the transparency checkbox
transparentSettingHint.message: Dims the window to 40%; restored to fully opaque on hover.

geocodedOf.description: Footer counter — $1 = geocoded count, $2 = total addressable listings

geocodingInProgress.description: Tooltip for the pulsing indicator — $1 = number of addresses pending geocoding

activeList.description: Label for the header dropdown that selects the active list

newList.description: Dropdown option that creates a new list

newListPrompt.description: Prompt dialog text for naming a new list

renameListPrompt.description: Prompt dialog text for renaming a list

deleteListConfirm.description: Confirmation message shown before deleting a list — $1 = list name
deleteListConfirm.message: Delete list "$1" and any listings not present in another list?

exportCsv.description: Button to export a list to CSV

importCsv.description: Button to import a list from a CSV file

importListPrompt.description: Prompt dialog text for naming the imported list

importDone.description: Message shown after import completes — $1 = imported count, $2 = skipped count

indexingPause.description: Tooltip for the header button that pauses indexing of new listings into the active list

indexingResume.description: Tooltip for the header button that resumes indexing of new listings into the active list

indexingOn.description: Short label on the header button when indexing is active

indexingOff.description: Short label on the header button when indexing is paused
